RESOLVED (was mis-scoped as "miss-variant draw parity", #651): NOT an RNG offset — the DP_DRAW_LOG/DP_C_DRAW_LOG_FILE seams show the Go and C draw streams byte-identical through the to-hit. Root cause was a set_fighting TIMING bug: Go stood a sleeping victim to POS_FIGHTING at combat entry, so the opener to-hit saw it awake (missable) and the prone-victim damage multiplier (dam *= 1 + (POS_FIGHTING-pos)/3) saw the stood position. C stands the victim inside damage(), AFTER both the AWAKE to-hit check and the multiplier. Fixed by deferring the victim POS_FIGHTING to the damage point, after CalculateDamage. Proven byte-equal on all six seeds.
